notes: Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (no WAF encountered, consistent with prior Home-Decor pass for this company). Discovery: robots.txt -> sitemaps/sitemap.xml -> collections.xml.gz (2528 URLs) grepped for clearance|outlet|final-sale|last-chance|end-of-line|discontinu|sale, cross-checked against the site's own /sale hub page (https://www.hipvan.com/sale) nav links. /sale itself is titled 'Furniture Sale Singapore: Sofa, Mattress, Bed & Dining Chairs' (1024 items) -- a generic temporary/ongoing promotional Sale hub, NOT itself Clearance-labeled, so EXCLUDED per the Sale-vs-Clearance rule (kept out of this file; it belongs to a separate Sale/Offers concept, not Clearance). Its child collections split cleanly: those whose own page title contains the word 'Clearance' (or, for as-is-furnishings-sale, whose title literally reads 'Buy Clearance Furniture...') are INCLUDED below as genuine Clearance PLPs. EXCLUDED as generic '(Sale)'-titled children with no clearance signal in title or copy: /sale/sale-decor-furnishings (149, 'Buy (Sale) Soft Furnishings'), /sale/sale-home-office (59, 'Buy (Sale) Office Stationery & Organizers'), /sale/sale-bathroom-vanity (66, 'Buy (Sale) Bathroom & Vanity'), /sale/sale-kitchen-tableware (103, 'Buy (Sale) Kitchen'), /lighting-sale-20-off (1, generic percent-off promo), /sale/tineco-up-to-20 (8, single-brand percent-off promo, not clearance). /warehouse-sale-study-room returned byte-identical title+qty (59, 'Buy (Sale) Office Stationery & Organizers') to /sale/sale-home-office -- treated as a duplicate/alias of that page and dropped rather than double-counted. /end-of-season-sale-2025 (listed in the sitemap) 404s live -- an expired/removed dated seasonal campaign; would have been excluded anyway as a temporary seasonal promotion, not permanent clearance. Every INCLUDED row below was opened and confirmed to be a real product grid with the site's own exact '(N items)' breadcrumb count (same qty-source methodology verified reliable in the prior Home-Decor pass for hipvan.com). Overlap is expected and not an error: several rows are overlapping room/type facets of the same underlying clearance stock pool (e.g. sofa-clearance is a subset of furniture-clearance and clearance-living-room; clearance-up-to-50-off (717) is close to but not exactly the sum of the type/room facets below it, implying it is the general umbrella Clearance collection with the others as narrower cuts) -- kept as separate rows per the 'different URL, different count -> keep both' rule rather than silently deduped. Four rows are flagged MANUAL REVIEW because their own page title/copy uses 'Sale' or a percent-off framing rather than the literal word 'Clearance', even though the underlying merchandising concept (as-is/floor-model/warehouse stock) is a common clearance-style signal -- flagged rather than guessed per brief guidance.
